claims.claim: Capital One completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services on May 18, 2025, bringing the Discover, PULSE and Diners Club International networks under Capital One.
claims.quote: Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF) today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services.
claims.title: Exhibit 99.1 - Capital One Completes Acquisition of Discover (Form 8-K)
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 8-K filed 2025-05-19. Press release also states: 'The Discover, PULSE, and Diners Club International networks will join our suite of offerings.'

claims.claim: The Capital One press release states the three network brands join Capital One's offerings and Discover-branded cards continue.
claims.quote: The Discover ® , PULSE ® , and Diners Club International ® networks will join our suite of offerings.
claims.title: Exhibit 99.1 - Capital One Completes Acquisition of Discover (Form 8-K)
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Merger agreement announced February 19, 2024; approvals: Fed and OCC April 18, 2025; Delaware State Bank Commissioner December 18, 2024; shareholder votes February 18, 2025.

claims.claim: The Federal Reserve approved the Capital One–Discover merger on April 18, 2025 and simultaneously fined Discover $100 million for overcharging interchange fees from 2007 through 2023.
claims.quote: The Board also entered into a consent order with Discover and assessed a fine of $100 million for overcharging certain interchange fees from 2007 through 2023.
claims.title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by Capital One Financial Corporation to merge with Discover Financial Services and issues a consent order with Discover
claims.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Names Capital One of McLean, Virginia and Discover of Riverwoods, Illinois. Relevant to acquirer/merchant partners: the interchange overcharge was a network-level misclassification.

claims.claim: Pre-merger, Discover Financial Services was headquartered at 2500 Lake Cook Road, Riverwoods, Illinois (Delaware corporation).
claims.quote: 2500 Lake Cook Road , Riverwoods , Illinois 60015 (Address of principal executive offices, including zip code)
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Predates the May 18, 2025 close. Capital One's own HQ is McLean, Virginia (8-K Ex. 99.1).

claims.claim: The brand family is Discover Network, PULSE and Diners Club International, collectively branded the Discover Global Network.
claims.quote: We also operate the Discover Network, the PULSE network (“PULSE”) and Diners Club International (“Diners Club”), collectively known as the Discover Global Network.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: FY2024 total network transaction volume was $621.9 billion: PULSE $328.3B, Network Partners $32.8B, Diners Club $41.4B, Discover Network proprietary $219.4B.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Dollars in millions, years 2024/2023/2022. Total Network Transaction Volume $621,913M (2024), $589,158M (2023), $549,857M (2022). Network Partners volume has declined three years running (44.5B -> 39.7B -> 32.8B).

claims.claim: Transactions processed on networks in FY2024: 3,750 million on Discover Network and 9,609 million on PULSE, 13,359 million in total.
claims.quote: Transactions Processed on Networks Discover Network 3,750 3,728 3,617 PULSE Network 9,609 7,705 6,200 Total Transaction Processed on Networks 13,359 11,433 9,817
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Counts in millions; PULSE transactions grew 25% in 2024 and 24% in 2023.

claims.claim: The 10-K describes network-to-network partners ('Network Alliances') as a revenue source via network assessment, discount and interchange fees, and Diners Club as a licensee network.
claims.quote: network assessment, discount and interchange fees from our network-to-network partners (“Network Alliances”)
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: The 10-K does not name individual alliance partners (JCB, UnionPay, RuPay absent from text).

claims.claim: PULSE is an EFT/PIN-debit network giving issuers ATM access domestically and internationally plus US merchant acceptance, and it also sells optional signature-debit processing.
claims.quote: PULSE offers a variety of optional products and services that produce income for the network, including signature debit transaction processing
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Message format: the 10-K does not use the terms 'single-message' or 'dual-message'; PULSE as an EFT network is single-message PIN debit by construction and Discover Network is a dual-message credit/signature network. Treat that classification as inference, not sourced.

claims.claim: PULSE extends reach via network-to-network agreements with other debit networks, under which the other network bears financial responsibility for its issuers' transactions.
claims.quote: When PULSE enters into a network-to-network agreement with another debit network, the other network’s participating financial institutions’ debit cards can be used at terminals in the PULSE network.
claims.title: Discover Financial Services Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024
claims.publisher: Discover Financial Services via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Discover Global Network's home page claims more than 439 million cards on the network, counted as open cards on Discover Network, Diners Club and network alliances as of December 2025.
claims.quote: There are more than 439 million cards that run on our global network.
claims.title: Discover Network - A Payments Network With Global Scale
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 1: 'Total cards include open cards on Discover Network, Diners Club International and network alliances. Based on information provided by network participants as of December 2025 and the Global ATM Intelligence Service study by Datos Insights data as of 12/31/2024.' Page footer © 2026 DFS Services LLC. Conflicts with 378+ million on Our Unique Network page (see contradictions).

claims.claim: Discover Global Network claims acceptance in more than 185 countries and territories.
claims.quote: Our global network is accepted in more than 185 countries and territories.
claims.title: Discover Network - A Payments Network With Global Scale
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote: 'Internal Discover Transaction Data, leveraging the average of transaction data from 2023-2025.' Same figure repeated on Reach and Acceptance and Diners Club pages.

claims.claim: The home page claims over $634 billion spent across Discover Network, Diners Club International and PULSE in 2025.
claims.quote: Customers spent over $634B across Discover Network, Diners Club International, and PULSE Networks in 2025.
claims.title: Discover Network - A Payments Network With Global Scale
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 3: 'Internal Discover Network Volume Data, total volume in 2024 and 2025.' Compare FY2024 10-K total of $621.9B; implies ~2% growth in 2025.

claims.claim: Discover Network claims 30+ network alliances based on signed Network Alliance agreements and lists partners including JCB, UnionPay, RuPay, Elo, BC Card, NAPAS, Prosa, Troy, mada, PayNet, SIBS, Cabal, DinaCard, NCCC, ATH (EVERTEC), Mercury, Bcard, AFS, areeba, Eazy, Dutch-Bangla Bank, Network International/JONET.
claims.quote: Discover® Network has 30+ network alliances 3 with other networks, issuers and payments organizations.
claims.title: Reach and Acceptance | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 3: 'Based on signed Network Alliance agreements.' The listed alliance blurbs on this page do NOT include Verve, Meeza, Bancomat or Uzcard, which the assignment context named; only 23 partners are described by name, so the 30+ figure is not fully enumerated on the page. BC Card blurb: cardholders 'utilize Discover Network, Diners Club International®, and PULSE® for international purchases and cash access outside of Korea.'

claims.claim: Discover Network claims acceptance at millions of merchant locations globally as of December 31, 2024.
claims.quote: Discover Network is accepted at millions of locations across the globe
claims.title: Reach and Acceptance | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 2: 'Based on data provided to Discover by merchants, acquiring institutions and other third parties as of December 31, 2024.' No specific merchant-location count is published.

claims.claim: The Our Unique Network page states Discover Network provides acceptance to 378+ million cards worldwide, citing RBR data as of 2024.
claims.quote: Discover Network is an international acceptance network that provides global acceptance to 378+ million cards worldwide.
claims.title: Our Unique Payments Network | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 1: 'Based on information provided by network participants, and RBR Data Services published as of 2024.' Differs from 439M on home page (Dec 2025 data).

claims.claim: Diners Club International has 40+ issuers in 35+ countries, counted as franchises with active Network Participation Agreements and cards in force.
claims.quote: Diners Club International ® is a premium issuing brand that has 40+ issuers in 35+ countries;
claims.title: Our Unique Payments Network | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote 2: issuers counted 'have active Network Participation Agreements (NPA) or Sublicense NPAs ... and include only those franchises with cards in force (CIF) in market.' Same figure on About Discover Network page.

claims.claim: Discover positions its three networks as a US/North America credit network (Discover), a global premium issuing/licensee network (Diners Club) and a US debit network with ATM reach (PULSE).
claims.quote: Discover Network provides acceptance to millions of cardholders across North America; Diners Club International —a premium issuing brand—has 40+ issuers in 35+ countries
claims.title: About Discover Network: Global Payment Solutions for Seamless, Secure Commerce | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page continues: 'PULSE allows greater accessibility for cardholders through their extensive ATM network.' No ATM count given.

claims.claim: PULSE describes itself as operating for more than 45 years and its careers link now points to capitalonecareers.com, consistent with Capital One ownership.
claims.quote: millions of domestic and international credit and debit cards are accepted at our ATMs
claims.title: About PULSE
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page gives no ATM count, issuer count or card count. Community references place PULSE in the Greater Houston area.
